title: Mesh
description: The mesh declaration of a repository, under .ai/repo/mesh/: whether this repository's shared servers participate in discovery of other running Majordomus instances, over which transports (multicast, broadcast fallback, rendezvous endpoints), and whom they trust. Absent, or enabled: false, means no discovery socket opens anywhere this repository's servers run — the default posture is that nothing leaves the machine, and this object is the one place a person changes that (ADR 0043). Trust allow entries are Ed25519 public keys; nothing secret belongs here.

schema.description: The format version of this object. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The declaration's identity within the kind.

enabled.description: The master switch. False, or absent, starts nothing.

multicast.description: UDP multicast, the preferred LAN mechanism.

group.description: The IPv4 multicast group, conventionally in 239.0.0.0/8.

ttl.description: The datagram TTL; 1 keeps announcements on the local segment.

broadcast.description: UDP broadcast, the controlled fallback; disabled unless declared.

networks.description: Directed broadcast addresses for explicit mode.

rendezvous.description: Other Majordomus servers to register with, for segments multicast cannot cross. Plain HTTP: a private network or an overlay is assumed.

trust.description: Who to trust. The default policy observes everyone and trusts no one.

allow.description: Ed25519 public keys (64 hex characters) trusted regardless of policy.
